name: Salmon, Rice and Broccoli
method: Heat the oven to 200C (180C fan). Mix the soy sauce and honey, place the salmon on a lined tray and brush the mixture over it.
Bake the salmon for 12 to 15 minutes until it flakes easily.
Meanwhile cook the rice following the pack instructions, usually about 12 minutes. Cut the broccoli into florets.
Steam or boil the broccoli for 4 to 5 minutes until tender but still bright green, then drain and toss with a little oil.
Divide the rice between two plates and top with the broccoli and salmon, spooning over any glaze from the tray.
